hints.text: Decimals are subtracted one place at a time. What has to be lined up before you start?
Line up the decimal points. Subtract the tenths, $6 - 2$, and then the ones, $8 - 3$. No regrouping is needed here.
The tenths give $4$ and the ones give $5$, so $8.6 - 3.2 = 5.4$.

explanation: Stack the numbers with the decimal points lined up, so each digit sits over the digit with the same place value.
Subtract the tenths: $6 - 2 = 4$ tenths, and no regrouping is needed.
Subtract the ones in the same way: $8 - 3 = 5$ ones.
Five ones and four tenths make $5.4$, so $8.6 - 3.2 = 5.4$.
